title: It Started With Two Girls
sentences: In January 1692, two girls in a minister’s house began having fits.
Betty Parris was nine, and her cousin Abigail Williams was eleven.
They lived with Reverend Samuel Parris in Salem Village.
They stared into space, made strange noises and seemed to be in pain.
In February, a doctor said they were under an evil hand.
Pressed to name their tormentors, the girls accused three women.
caption:
In January 1692, two girls in a minister’s house began having fits. Salem would never be the same.
